name: Srichand Rewards Member
benefits_en: Single-level points programme: every ฿25 of net spend (after discounts and shipping) earns 1 point; remainders under ฿25 earn nothing. Points post within 17 days for srichand.com / Shopee / Lazada once the account is linked, and within 48 hours for store receipts uploaded in LINE. Points last one year; join by adding LINE @srichand1948 (or @sasidiary) and registering with SMS OTP. No tiers are published.
benefits_th: สะสมแต้ม Srichand Rewards: ทุก 25 บาท = 1 คะแนน (คิดจากยอดชำระสุทธิ) สมัครผ่าน LINE @srichand1948
